module_summary: AXI-Lite read to pipelined Wishbone bridge: accepted AR requests issue WB strobes (with a one-deep stall shadow), returned data fills a small FIFO tracked by first/mid/last pointers, with error-flush handling.

anchors.name: dfifo
anchors.why: Return data FIFO written on WB ack, read at r_last for AXI R

anchors.name: o_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR ready dropped on stall, FIFO full or error state

anchors.name: o_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid set on WB ack/err, cleared when FIFO drains

anchors.name: o_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data from dfifo head

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe issued per AXI read request until not stalled

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone word address from araddr or shadow r_addr

anchors.name: i_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address converted to WB word address

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: WB acknowledge writing data into dfifo and advancing r_mid

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone return data stored in dfifo

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Bus error flush mode: halts strobes, blocks arready, alters rresp

anchors.name: r_mid
anchors.why: FIFO write pointer for returned WB data

anchors.name: r_last
anchors.why: FIFO read pointer advancing on AXI R handshake

anchors.name: r_first
anchors.why: Request count pointer advanced on AR handshake

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle while strobing or acks outstanding

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: WB stall holding strobe and triggering shadow request

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: WB bus error entering err_state and setting rresp

anchors.name: i_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid launching WB strobes

anchors.name: i_axi_rready
anchors.why: AXI master accepts read data, advancing r_last

anchors.name: o_axi_rresp
anchors.why: Read response: OKAY, SLVERR at error, DECERR after

anchors.name: r_stb
anchors.why: Shadow request pending while WB stalled

anchors.name: r_addr
anchors.why: Shadow address held for stalled second request

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag holding arready low

anchors.name: wb_outstanding
anchors.why: Counts WB requests awaiting ack

anchors.name: wb_pending
anchors.why: Acks outstanding; keeps o_wb_cyc asserted

anchors.name: err_loc
anchors.why: FIFO slot of the errored transaction for rresp

groups.name: Return data FIFO
groups.description: Request/return/read pointers and storage for WB return data

groups.name: Wishbone request issue
groups.description: Issues WB strobes/addresses with stall shadow and tracks outstanding acks

groups.name: AXI read channel control
groups.description: Generates arready, rvalid, rdata and rresp

groups.name: Error handling
groups.description: Flushes outstanding requests after WB error and marks error responses
